4976610.name: Chabad Williamsburg Virginia
4976610.note: COLlive, 6 June 2021 ('New Shluchim to Williamsburg, Virginia'): 'Rabbi Mendy and Esther Heber (nee Steinmetz), along with their daughter Devorah Leah, are the newest Chabad Shluchim to Williamsburg, Virginia'; Williamsburg 'is home to hundreds of Jewish students at the prestigious William & Mary'; 'They were appointed by the head shliach of Virginia, Rabbi Yossel Kranz.' Its chabad.org listing went up 24 Feb 2021.

6867362.name: Chabad of Charlottesville
6867362.note: The community side of Rabbi Shlomo and Chana Mayer's work. Lubavitch.com, 2 Aug 2002 ('New Center in Charlottesville'): 'Rabbi Shlomo and Chana Mayer arrived to this campus town, home to the University of Virginia and some 500 Jewish families, last January'; 'Torah classes and prayer services conducted at the Mayer's home off campus'. COLlive, 10 June 2025 ('New Shluchim Join Chabad of UVA', https://collive.com/new-shluchim-join-chabad-of-uva/): 'For the past 24 years, Reuvi's parents, Rabbi Shlomo and Channa Mayer, have been the heart of Chabad in Charlottesville—serving both students and the broader community'; their son Rabbi Reuvi and Shani Mayer now lead Chabad for UVA undergraduates, while the parents 'will continue to focus on graduate students, alumni, and the Charlottesville community'. This listing only went up 24 Apr 2025, when the work was split.
